text:
maya: quick sweep — two new open models showed up in intake: raven-13b-std and bryce-7b-q4. we need license confirmation + perf profiles before they go into catalog. who can own each?

samuel: i can take raven-13b. will run perf jobs and generate a profile. rough ETA: EOD Friday unless infra flakiness.

joel: i'll pick up bryce-7b. starting legal ping now — there's a custom dataset note in the metadata that might need extra review.

liz: tagging for rollout gating: once perf + license are green we still need: schema mapping (response shape), quantization recommendation, and example prompts for evals.

maya: great — can you add owners to the intake record? also ping infra if you need dedicated nodes for long seq perf.

samuel: added myself to intake record. plan for perf:
```
./bench --model raven-13b-std --seq 2048 --batch 8 --iters 200 
# capture p50/p95, gpu mem, kv hit rate
```
will push raw logs to /mnt/perf/raven/ and create a short profile doc.

licensing-bot: license-check started for bryce-7b-q4 (ID: LC-4821). Expect human review due to flagged third-party weights.

joel: noted. liz — do we need product signoff for bryce because of the dataset note?

liz: yes — product should approve prompt examples and safety evals. tagging @maya for final product check if you can.

maya: happy to review product side once legal clears. quick dependency note: if raven needs quantization profile, RDQ team may want to bench int8 vs int4 — samuel please call them early.

samuel: will loop in rdq @rdq-signal. also fyi perf-bot will run the nightly matrix; i'll kick off an ad-hoc run now.

perf-bot: adhoc perf matrix started for raven-13b-std (seqs: 512,1024,2048). posting artifacts to S3 when complete.

joel: legal flagged a CLA with upstream author for bryce — may take 2 business days. moving bryce to blocked->legal-review in intake.

liz: thanks. action items summary:
- samuel: perf profile + bench logs for raven (ETA Fri)
- joel: legal review for bryce (started)
- liz: prepare schema/quant suggestions and product prompt checklist
- maya: final product review after legal

maya: if anyone hits blockers, drop a quick note here. otherwise i'll run a catalog gating checklist next Tue and try to fold these in if ready. :thumbsup:

samuel: noted, will post perf gist when runs finish.

joel: will update intake status as legal progresses.

licensing-bot: bryce-7b-q4 license check: human review required — assigned to legal-team.

maya: awesome, thanks everyone.
